name: Certutil Suspicious Remote Download / Decode
description: Detects certutil.exe invoked with -urlcache, -split, or -decode flags to download or decode arbitrary files.
explanation: Certutil is a Windows certificate utility frequently abused as a Living-off-the-Land Binary (LOLBin) to download remote payloads.
investigation_steps: Extract the target URL or source/destination file paths from cmdline.
Check FIM events for files created in the destination directory.
Submit downloaded file hash to threat intelligence feeds.
